Here is a transcription of the historical, Latin-language parish register pages shown in **image_1edc7d.png**.

Because 19th-century cursive and Latin abbreviations can be challenging to parse, standard expansions have been applied where clear (e.g., *filiia* for daughter, *filius* for son, *susscepti* / *sponsores* for godparents/sponsors), and a few highly obscured place names or words are noted with brackets.
